{"task": "Write a retrospective Security Council record on the 31 August 2023 UNIFIL mandate renewal. Preserve what the Council adopted and explain the supplied national positions. Distinguish both a point of overlap and a concrete difference when the relevant national sources are available.", "sources": [{"id": "vote", "text": "On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council voted on draft S/2023/641 submitted by France. It was adopted as resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour and none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining. Brazil voted in favour."}, {"id": "operative", "text": "Operative paragraph 1 extended UNIFIL's existing mandate until 31 August 2024. Paragraph 15 reaffirmed its independence in carrying out mandated tasks without prior permission and its continued coordination with Lebanon's Government under the status-of-forces agreement."}, {"id": "brazil", "text": "Brazil supported UNIFIL's continuing work. It judged that the French text kept the mandate robust and allowed UNIFIL to operate freely, while addressing some of Lebanon's concerns."}]}
